facts.text: John expressed that being around others who shared his values and passion reminded him of the importance of making a difference through activism.

evidence.quote: It was amazing being around others who shared the same values and passion as me. It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism.
Surrounding yourself with determined people striving for the same goals can be really motivating.

facts.text: John stated that striving for progress is crucial.
